title: Arjun – Prince of Bali
description: Arjun, The Prince of Bali has to go on a journey along with his friends and his pet tiger Zimbu to find the seven pieces of a magical sword, the only weapon that can defeat the Evil Hiranya who has captured his kingdom and parents.
